title: Game knowledge entry
description: Metadata and capability summary for a single football game on a single platform. Lives at data/games/<game-id>/game.yaml; companion file editor-grid.yaml (validated by coordinate-map.schema.json) sits beside it.

game_id.description: Stable identifier, lowercase kebab-case (e.g. 'ncaa-06-ps2'). Must match the parent directory name.

platform.description: Same title on different platforms = different files (different editors, different limits).

editors.description: Which in-game editors this title provides. Each editor's verification is tracked separately because they're often documented unevenly.

limits.description: Numeric or categorical limits known to apply. Schema is permissive (additionalProperties: true) — well-known keys are documented below; per-game extras are allowed.

max_plays_per_playbook.description: Max plays the user can fit in a single playbook used in a game.

max_formations_per_playbook.description: Max formations a single playbook can include.

max_custom_plays_total.description: Save-slot cap for custom plays across the whole game profile.

max_custom_formations_total.description: Save-slot cap for custom formations across the whole game profile.

max_custom_playbooks_total.description: Save-slot cap for custom playbooks themselves.

max_routes_per_play.description: Max number of eligible receivers that can run routes (rest are forced to block).

max_route_segments.description: Max break points / segments allowed when drawing a single route.
